description: Two Family Support for Children with Disabilities packages report service use and cost by service category. Named categories include child-focused and behavioural/developmental support, specialised services and out-of-home placement. Native coverage is April 2018 through December 2021; the cost series is quarterly. Caseload and cost are companion measures with a shared data dictionary and regional-map descriptors, not identical tables. XLSX files and PDF visualisations are listed. Exact units, individual facility capacity and row-level geography are not established in metadata. Component identities remain distinct; this grouping does not imply identical files, seamless coverage or complete provider coverage. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue carries the Alberta source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Native licence statements are Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs remain unverified. HEAD checks returned 200 for the CUDC landing page and 403 for the original Alberta landing page. No linked dataset, archive, model, document or code body was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are unknown. A third source-defined FSCD companion provides active caseload by disability type, with native coverage April 2010–March 2021. Its PDF visualisation label instead extends to December 2021; the discrepancy is preserved. XLSX caseload and dictionary descriptors are listed. This is service use by recipient category, not disability incidence or an assertion that the same children can be summed across every service table.
